arm_solver_web_subagent.calls_made: exactly 5 WebFetch and 2 WebSearch, in the frozen order, no retries, no substitutions, no self-chosen targets
arm_solver_web_subagent.finding: WebFetch refused 5 of 5, including example.com. WebSearch succeeded 2 of 2 and returned substantive extracted page text. IDENTICAL to the orchestrator arm on every one of the seven frozen probes.
arm_solver_web_subagent.incidental_observation: The agent reported that the 'github' MCP server injected usage instructions into its context after its first tool batch, for tools not exposed in its schema. Recorded as an environment property, not acted on: it is a server-level injection that reaches solver-closed and solver-web alike, so it is arm-symmetric and does not differentiate the treatment. Noted here so the execution session can confirm arm symmetry at runtime rather than rediscover it.

correction_to_the_prior_turn: The source-verification turn reported that fetches to en.wikipedia.org and www.bls.gov were refused 'while WebSearch worked normally', which implied a domain-selective block. The frozen probe shows the block is total: example.com is refused too. The observation was right; the implied scope was wrong. Superseded in scope by the completed subagent arm: the total-block finding is now confirmed on the solver's own path, not only the orchestrator's.

interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.environment_fingerprint_E: SEARCH-CAPABLE, FETCH-BLOCKED. WebSearch functional and returning substantive page text; WebFetch refused by the network egress proxy for every target attempted, including a trivially benign control domain.
interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.conclusion: MEASURED, both arms of the probe agreeing on all seven targets: the key-verification environment and the solver retrieval environment share one egress path. The blockage observed during key verification DOES transfer to the treatment claim, and the treatment is scoped to E.
interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.what_this_makes_the_treatment: Retrieval-enabled under a search-capable, fetch-blocked environment. The solver can read ABOUT a page through the search layer but cannot open one to verify a quote, a date or a number at source, and cannot resolve a conflict between two sources by opening either. This is materially WEAKER than unrestricted browsing and must be stated as such wherever the word retrieval appears.
interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.what_is_still_open: Nothing about the pre-run reachability of the two tools. E may still change during production; the split-environment halt rule in specification section 7 governs that case.
interpretation_under_the_frozen_rules.transfer_rule_status: SATISFIED. The transfer was licensed by measurement in both arms, not by architectural expectation.

no_analysis_conditioning: This probe does not drop, reweight, screen or condition any production item. No item is excluded because a key source was unreachable or a domain was blocked. See docs/EXP004_STAGE0A_M_SPECIFICATION.md.
